events.title: Uptime Monitoring Notification
events.restatement: Monitor the health of each service in uptime-probe.json. Notify once after two consecutive unhealthy checks, resetting the counter on a healthy check. One check was already unhealthy.

events.reason: A new tool is needed. FORGE will draft several programs and test them against your data.
